//: Three profiles, one for each way this app reaches a phone.
'preview' is the one that matters day to day: it produces a single .apk
file that installs by tapping a link. That is how the mill gets the app —
no store, no review, a new version in everybody's hands in minutes.
The default Android build is an .aab, which the Play Store accepts and a
phone cannot install, so buildType has to be said explicitly.
